title: Don't waste our time: CJI Surya Kant refuses urgent hearing in plea over NEET, police excesses against CJP protestors
description: The Supreme Court on Wednesday declined urgent hearing in a petition calling for reforms to the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) and alleging that police and other forces deployed in the national capital were committing excesses against students during ongoing protests led by the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP).
